business_problem: Jingzhunxue needed a low-latency, high-stability infrastructure for an AI tutoring experience that mixes real-time audio and video dialog, ASR, TTS, formula recognition, long-context reasoning, and strong safety controls. User traffic spikes heavily at night and on weekends, so the company also needed GPU elasticity and a way to choose and tune foundation models for educational accuracy and content safety.
solution_summary: Jingzhunxue built its AI tutor stack on Alibaba Cloud around ECS, GPU cloud servers, SLS, ARMS, QwenMax, and Bailian. The infrastructure layer provides a stable elastic compute base with 99.975% SLA and 30-second scale-out for evening or weekend demand spikes, while SLS and ARMS give full-link observability so the team can identify bottlenecks and trigger what it calls compute self-healing before users feel service degradation. On the model side, the company is an early deep user of QwenMax and uses Bailian to train an education-specific model behind the Hanzue Teacher super-agent. That model stack handles personalized tutoring, AI homework correction, automatic question-bank extraction, and long-context educational dialog while integrating speech and teaching workflows. The result is a production tutoring system that mixes domain-tuned AI teaching capability with elastic infrastructure built for real-time interactive learning.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
solution_components.role: Provides the stable elastic compute base for the real-time tutoring platform.

solution_components.name: GPU cloud servers
solution_components.role: Supply the accelerated compute used for deep-learning iteration and AI tutor inference.

solution_components.name: Log Service SLS
solution_components.role: Captures operational telemetry and supports rapid detection of AI-service bottlenecks.

solution_components.name: Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS)
solution_components.role: Provides end-to-end observability and supports automatic expansion when demand spikes.

solution_components.name: QwenMax
solution_components.role: Acts as the core foundation model for tutoring, homework correction, and educational dialog understanding.

solution_components.name: Bailian
solution_components.role: Hosts the education-vertical training flow used to build the Hanzue Teacher model stack.

data_flow: Student voice and text interactions are processed through the tutoring stack, where speech tasks and educational dialog context are routed to the QwenMax and Bailian-trained model layer. Responses are returned to the learner in real time, while SLS and ARMS monitor the inference path and trigger rapid scaling when demand spikes at peak study periods.
business_outcome: Jingzhunxue turned its tutoring product into a real-time AI teaching service that can scale nationally. The platform holds response time to 1.2 to 1.8 seconds, scales within 30 seconds under demand spikes, reduces labor cost by 35%, lifts overall efficiency by 40%, and supports a tutoring experience designed to give many students personalized one-to-one guidance at a much lower delivery cost.
metrics: automatic expansion can complete within 30 seconds
architecture_clues: Peak demand is highly time-dependent, so 30-second elastic expansion is treated as a core product requirement.
The tutoring stack combines infrastructure observability with an education-vertical model rather than using a generic chatbot directly.
QwenMax supplies the base reasoning layer, while Bailian is used to train a domain-specific education model for the super-agent.
The system handles multimodal tutoring tasks including dialog, speech, and structured educational content extraction.
